QA-21874 is a PASS on 4 of 5 channels. The Facebook leg could not be evaluated, so the PASS carries that caveat. The report is at `results/2026-10-20/QA-21874-report.md`.

I ran the UCLA account and the "University of California, Los Angeles" brand, for the Oct 12–18 default week. Each leg compares the first post's engagements divided by Total Followers × 100 against its Response Rate.

| Channel | Calculated | First post Response Rate | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Facebook | 0.1264% | "–" (no data) | not evaluable |
| Instagram | 0.3892% | 0.39% | PASS |
| Twitter | 0.0297% | 0.03% | PASS |
| TikTok | 0.0566% | 0.06% | PASS |
| LinkedIn | 0.0683% | 0.07% | PASS |

- **Facebook:** the first post is from Oct 14, where Response Rate is blank. All 16 other Facebook posts that do show a rate match the formula. The blank posts fall exactly on Oct 14, 15, 17 and 18, and the Facebook Posts Insights Disruption banner was active. I infer missing follower data on those days but did not confirm it day by day.
- **Scope:** I only ran the UCLA account. The Description table also lists Viacom/MTV and Wasserman/Gatorade for Tuesday, but the case Notes name only UCLA, so I left those out.
- **Known bugs:** the case lists no open bugs, and none interfered with the assertions. No bugs filed.

I did no skill or registry maintenance, as instructed.
